title: About Dzvinco
intro: Dzvinco is a space to reconnect with yourself. Notice how you feel, give your thoughts a home in a private journal, and find little moments of calm even on busy days.
introExtended: Sometimes all you need is a small pause. Take a few gentle breaths, write down what's on your mind, or choose a practice that feels right today. Revisit your mood story, celebrate small wins, and move towards personal goals at your own pace.

Evolution.title: From a single check-in to a manageable next step
Evolution.description: Start with a single check-in. Pick a short practice that fits right now and watch how your state changes over time — at your own pace.

stepDescriptions.happened: You rate stress, mood, energy or focus, or write a diary entry — whenever it suits you.
stepDescriptions.means: Dzvinco brings your check-ins together in a clear picture of your day, helping you notice how you have been feeling.
stepDescriptions.next: In the guide you choose a short practice: breathing, calming, a meditation or a tip.
stepDescriptions.action: You decide: do the exercise, pick another one or simply come back later.
stepDescriptions.evidence: In My Progress, follow your own story of moods, personal goals, and meaningful moments.

context.title: Find your next small step
context.description: Today you might just pause and listen to yourself. Tomorrow, revisit a note or try a practice. Your own pace is enough.

signal.title: Check-in
signal.description: Name your mood in a few taps or let your thoughts find a home in your journal.

prediction.title: Practice
prediction.description: A short exercise from the library: breathing, calming, a meditation or a tip. You choose what fits right now.

validation.title: Your history
validation.description: Look back at your notes and notice the moments you want to remember.

Insights.title: See how you change
Insights.description: Every entry is part of your story. Notice changes, remember small victories, and find what helps you feel more grounded.

dynamics.title: How things change
dynamics.description: Watch how your stress, mood, energy and focus shift over time — and notice what helps.

records.title: Only your data
records.description: Statistics, goals and achievements are built on your own check-ins — with no comparison to others.

explanations.title: Clear explanations
explanations.description: Every figure in plain language: what it means for you.

Start.title: Start with your first check-in
Start.description: Create your space — and your check-ins, journal and progress will always be with you. Or try a 30-second exercise first, no sign-in needed.

business.title: For companies
business.description: Personal self-support for employees and pilot formats for organizations with aggregated data. Employers cannot see private journals or check-ins. Companies are invited to join a pilot — get in touch.

user.title: For yourself
user.description: A place where your feelings matter: mood check-ins, private thoughts, short practices, and small personal wins.

research.title: For researchers
research.description: We are looking for university and institute partners for joint research. Any study happens only with separate participant consent and ethics approval.

Architecture.title: How Dzvinco is organized
Architecture.overviewDescription: The personal service, company pilots and the research track are developed separately, each with its own data access boundaries.
Architecture.overviewDescriptionLead: The personal service, company pilots and the research track are developed separately, each with its own data access boundaries.
Architecture.overviewDescriptionFollowup: Personal records belong to the user and are not shared with companies or researchers without separate explicit consent.
Architecture.interactionHint: Choose a track from the chips or click the card on the right to learn more.

core.title: Research track
core.description: Behind Dzvinco is QDIP.ai's Decision Intelligence approach: connecting context, comparing possible next steps, and making complex choices easier to understand.

b2c.title: Personal space
b2c.description: Check-ins, journal, exercises, goals and progress — available right now. Start today.

loop.title: Data boundaries
loop.description: Sign-in through a secured account and owner-only access to personal records.

Value.title: Why Dzvinco
Value.description: Caring for yourself starts with paying attention. Here you can be honest with yourself, keep what matters close, and find strength for your next small step.

points.cohort: Your records are yours alone: no comparison with others and no access for your employer.
points.explainable: Choose what you need today: write a thought, check in with your mood, or try a short exercise.
points.outcome: Dzvinco helps you tune in to how you feel, find small moments to pause, and return to what gives you a sense of balance.

Technology.title: Technology with people at its heart
Technology.description: Dzvinco brings human-centred support together with Decision Intelligence from QDIP.ai. Where personal notes capture how a day felt, decision-support technology helps make sense of context and possible next steps. People and their choices remain at the centre.
